objective: Port the complete LQR_lp2.slx double-inverted-pendulum controller into the current C++ project, preserving model parameters and behavior while exposing only manual-upright balance start operation.

acceptance_tests.model_codegen: passed with sldrt.tlc on 2026-09-03; temporary generated files removed after inspection
acceptance_tests.device_enumeration: passed; Dev1 PCI-6602 and PCI-1723,BID#15 detected
acceptance_tests.encoder_input_probe: passed; Dev1/ctr0, Dev1/ctr1, and Dev1/ctr2 input tasks created and read; no output tasks created

known: Operator manually raises both pendulum links before issuing balance start.
balance start captures current first-link, second-link, and cart counts as the controller references.
First-link encoder is X4, 2500 PPR, 10000 counts per revolution on Dev1/ctr1.
Second-link encoder is X4, 1000 PPR, 4000 counts per revolution on Dev1/ctr2.
Second-link A/B use PCI-6602 CTR2 SOURCE pin 34 and CTR2 AUX pin 66 through default routing.
Second-link Z is optional on CTR2 GATE pin 67 and is not used.
The controller path executes every 0.005 seconds.
All encoder digital filters are disabled at 0 us, matching the source model.
implemented: Three simultaneous PCI-6602 encoder input tasks for cart, first link, and second link
Source-model angle composition and wrap-to-pi behavior
Six-state LQR with model literals 150.31, 23.63, -93.74, -3.25, -10, and -11.64
ACC2VOL Ts=0.005, velocity saturation +/-0.6, P=0.18, I=27, and voltage saturation +/-2
Source-model velocity-integrator reset when either absolute link angle is >= pi/18
CSV telemetry for both link angles, rates, encoder counts, controller state, and AO command
preserved: Physical limit debounce and immediate output shutdown
AO0=0 V before Servo OFF shutdown ordering
Manual utilities, optional homing, and telemetry logging
unresolved_blockers: Physical balance behavior cannot be called hardware-verified without an operator-authorized supervised motion run.
